canonicalReason: dm.de is the only German market source: Balea is a dm private label, so the dm.de product page (GTIN 4066447990126, 250 ml) doubles as the brand-owner page. The list is rendered pipe-separated ('COCO|GLUCOSIDE' = Coco-Glucoside, the hyphen is rendered as a pipe) and has no truncation marker. A user-uploaded database (INKEEDecoder, support only) shows the same 13 items in the same order. No second German retailer exists (dm exclusive brand) and no pack photo was available, so this is a single-origin freeze.
normalization: Split the canonical raw INCI on ',' (not on commas inside locants such as '1,2-'), merged split synonym entries such as 'Aqua (Water)' / 'Aqua/Water/Eau' into one item each; per ingredient: lower-case, trim, collapse internal whitespace, remove whitespace around '/'; drop a trailing period and any leading label such as 'Inhaltsstoffe:'; keep parentheses, asterisks and hyphens as published; join the normalized ingredients with '|' and sha256 the UTF-8 string.
notes: Single-origin freeze: dm.de is both retailer and brand owner.
